Package net.boricj.bft.ctf

Class CTFHeader

java.lang.Object
net.boricj.bft.ctf.CTFHeader
public class CTFHeader extends Object
Represents the CTF dictionary header. Contains magic, version, flags, parent/compilation unit info, and section offsets. Structure (per CTF spec v3): - cth_magic (2), cth_version (1), cth_flags (1) - cth_parlabel (4), cth_parname (4), cth_cuname (4) - cth_lbloff (4), cth_objtoff (4), cth_funcoff (4) - cth_objtidxoff (4), cth_funcidxoff (4), cth_varoff (4) - cth_typeoff (4), cth_stroff (4), cth_strlen (4) Total: 52 bytes
